    a.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,

FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a
  ON s.DEPARTMENT = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d

) ls
  ON ls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE s.LAST_NAME LIKE 'K%'
GROUP BY
    s.FULL_NAME,
    a.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER

SELECT
    s.FULL_NAME,
    a.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS total_mailing_lists,
    AVG(ls.list_size) AS avg_list_size
FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a
  ON s.DEPARTMENT = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
  ON d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME = s.FULL_NAME
JOIN MOIRA_LIST l
  ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
 AND l.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
JOIN (
    SELECT MOIRA_LIST_KEY, COUNT(*) AS list_size
    FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL
    GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY
) ls
  ON ls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE s.LAST_NAME LIKE 'K%'
GROUP BY
    s.FULL_NAME,
    a.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER

SELECT
  s.FULL_NAME,
  a.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS total_mailing_lists,
  AVG(list_size.sz) AS avg_list_size
FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a
  ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
  ON d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME = s.FULL_NAME
LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST l
  ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
 AND l.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT MOIRA_LIST_KEY, COUNT(*) AS sz
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL
  GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY
) list_size ON list_size.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE s.LAST_NAME LIKE 'K%'
GROUP BY s.FULL_NAME, a.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
